title: Dot Product of Vectors
extracted_text:
The dot product of two vectors a and b of magnitude |a| and |b| is
a · b = |a||b| cos θ, where θ represents the angle between the vectors
and determines the direction of the vectors.
diagram_summary: Three vector diagrams showing the dot product formula: left diagram shows vectors a and b with angle θ; middle diagram shows vectors a and b with angle θ and projection; right diagram shows angle θ between vectors.
